What changed, and why?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run verify:public`

## Scope and provenance

- [ ] No credentials, private world data, runtime profiles, or unlicensed assets
- [ ] Known compatibility limits are documented
- [ ] Canonical server results, draft recovery, and existing user data are preserved
